channel.title: Paksh: International
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Banking Stock Swoon in Europe Is a Sign of Caution, Not Panic
item.description: A selloff in banking stocks is rarely comforting. But after three years of strong gains, the latest pullback in European lenders looks more like a reset than a crash. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Escalating fighting in Yemen worsens food security crisis
item.description: Aid agencies in Yemen highlighted the growing hunger emergency sparked by renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops, after mobile health clinics reported that hundreds of children displaced by the violence are… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ukraine to Halt Russian Refinery Attacks With Condition
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine will cease attacks on Russian oil refineries if Russia halts its own energy-related attacks. This condition was presented as a potential pathway to stopping the strikes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: India condemns ‘dastardly attack’ on Saudi Arabia airport that killed 12; Pakistan calls Houthi strikes ‘heinous’
item.description: Saudi Arabia-Houthi conflict: The Ministry of External Affairs called the attacks “unacceptable” and said the repeated attacks on civilians and civilian targets must cease immediately. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: US Commander By His Side, Air Force Chief Says "They Don't Let Us Near" F-35 Jets
item.description: Air Chief Marshal AP Singh and General Kevin Schneider during the press conference Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: ट्रंप और पुतिन की ऑयल डील से जेलेंस्की हैरान, रूस-यूक्रेन युद्ध हुआ और भीषण
item.description: रूस और यूक्रेन के बीच चल रही जंग एक बार फिर बेहद खतरनाक मोड़ पर पहुंच गई है. इसी बीच अमेरिका के पूर्व राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप और रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन के बीच तेल आपूर्ति को लेकर एक अहम सहमति की खबरें आ रही हैं. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Gaza Ceasefire Stalled a Year After US-Brokered Deal, NGOs Say
item.description: A year after a US-brokered ceasefire was intended to end the war in Gaza, progress has stalled, with more than 100 NGOs stating the ceasefire "exists in name only." While a ceasefire was promised, Palestinians report that the past 12… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: China militia boat sighted near Taiwan's east coast
item.description: A Chinese militia boat was observed for the first time off the east coast of Taiwan, according to a patrol. The sighting occurred in waters near Taiwan's east coast. One report also raised questions about whether China is seeking to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Germany Considers Joining UK-Italy-Japan Fighter Jet Project
item.description: Germany is reportedly considering joining the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), a fighter jet project involving the United Kingdom, Italy, and Japan. This potential move follows speculation that the GCAP could be open to Germany after a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: UN Envoy Warns of Escalation in Yemen, Middle East Travel Advisories Issued
item.description: A United Nations envoy has warned that Yemen has returned to a "full-scale war" and urged for dialogue. Concurrently, the U.S. Embassy in Jordan and an EU aviation group have issued advisories against traveling to the Middle East. An… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Ukraine Peace Plan Discussed in Miami with US Envoys
item.description: Ukrainian negotiators traveled to Miami, United States, to discuss a new peace plan aimed at resolving the ongoing conflict with Russia. Sources indicated that the plan is comprehensive and intended to break the current impasse. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: South Korea Test-Flies First Domestic Hypersonic Weapon
item.description: South Korea has successfully test-flown its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon, according to Channel News Asia. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rubio discusses NATO defense spending with Portugal
item.description: US Senator Marco Rubio arrived in Portugal to discuss defense spending and NATO's focus, particularly concerning the Lajes air base. He stated that US pressure on NATO allies to increase defense budgets is "not hostile." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Two Nations Ally with Saudi Arabia Against Houthi Attacks
item.description: Two nations have allied with Saudi Arabia to counter Houthi rebels, with a large plan reportedly in place to encircle them. In a related development, Houthi rebels launched a significant attack on two airports in Saudi Arabia, resulting in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Satellite Images Show Chinese Military Jets in Laos
item.description: Satellite images reveal Chinese military aircraft, including attack jets, have been stationed at a military facility in Laos. This development has prompted questions regarding China's expanding military presence and influence in the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US and China Discuss Reciprocal Nuclear Site Visits
item.description: The United States and China are reportedly discussing reciprocal visits to nuclear sites. This comes amid concerns about a potential new arms race between the two global powers. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mali Junta Forces Retake Strategic Town of Kidal
item.description: Malian junta forces have retaken the strategic northern town of Kidal from separatist groups. Separatists had previously announced their withdrawal from the town. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Yemen Conflict and Civilian Displacement
item.description: Fighting continues in Yemen, forcing civilians to flee their homes. One family seeking refuge was observed in a shop in the city of Taiz. The ongoing conflict's specific combatants and broader implications remain subjects of inquiry. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: France Tests Nuclear-Capable Missile Without Warhead
item.description: France successfully test-fired a nuclear-capable missile without a payload, observed by President Emmanuel Macron. The launch was conducted without a warhead. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran trains women with firearms amid US tensions
item.description: In Iran, women are reportedly training with AK-47 rifles as part of preparations for a potential US ground invasion. This training is framed as a readiness to "sacrifice." The coverage indicates these actions are in response to perceived… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Makkah Alliance to Hold Emergency Talks on Houthi Attacks
item.description: Members of the Makkah defence alliance are scheduled to hold an emergency meeting in Riyadh to discuss engaging with the Houthis, following recent attacks. The alliance is reportedly considering how to address the ongoing Houthi actions. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: WHO Criticizes Delays in Aid Delivery to Gaza
item.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) has expressed strong disapproval of the delays in delivering essential aid into the Gaza Strip. The organization warns of potentially devastating consequences resulting from these hindrances. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Iraq Approves 40 Daily Flights for Iranian Airlines to Najaf
item.description: Iraq has granted Iranian airlines permission to operate 40 daily flights to and from the city of Najaf. This decision follows an exemption from U.S. sanctions that previously restricted such flights. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: China Expands Presence on Antelope Reef in South China Sea
item.description: Satellite images indicate that China is accelerating construction activities on Antelope Reef in the South China Sea. The latest imagery reveals a significant increase in the pace of work on the reef. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
